answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 32202 Country: India Title: What about Regarding Jamate Islami hind & Ahle Hadees ,is this within boundry of Islam ? Question: What about Regarding Jamate Islami hind & Ahle Hadees ,is this within boundry of Islam ? is they are in right path according to Holy Quran & Sunnah? Answer ID: 32202 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/L=319/TL=1432) Jama’at Islami or Ghair Muqallidin are not out of the fold of Islam, but these two sects are on deviant due to their difference with the majority of Ummah i.e. Ahl Sunnah wa al-Jama’ah in many issues. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
